name: E2E Gate (Vercel Playwright)

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [vercel.deployment.success]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  compute-and-dispatch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      (
        github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' &&
        github.event.action == 'vercel.deployment.success' &&
        github.event.client_payload.environment == 'preview' &&
        (
          github.event.client_payload.git.branch == 'playwright' ||
          github.event.client_payload.git.ref == 'playwright'
        )
      ) || (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
      )
    outputs:
      web_url: ${{ steps.set.outputs.web_url }}
      git_sha: ${{ steps.set.outputs.git_sha }}
    steps:
      - id: set
        run: |
          # TODO: replace with real URL from your Vercel payload when ready
          echo "web_url=https://comend-git-playwright-comend.vercel.app" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "git_sha=${{ github.event.client_payload.git.sha || github.event.inputs.git_sha || github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  run-tests:
    needs: compute-and-dispatch
    uses: ./.github/workflows/comend-e2e-playwright-run.yml
    with:
      web_url: ${{ needs.compute-and-dispatch.outputs.web_url }}
      git_sha: ${{ needs.compute-and-dispatch.outputs.git_sha }}
    secrets: inherit
